source_authority.scope_override: D14 engineering only; not Qwen SFT

identity.identifiers: Immutable, case/Unicode preserving; no alias normalization or source token repair
identity.versioned_references: Foreign keys retain every primary-key component and schema version; edits/corrections append revisions, never overwrite historical knowledge
identity.supplemental_keys: Initial engineering proposal; consumer schemas and producer mappings incomplete

provenance.source_refs: Exact source_id/version plus raw_id, hash and locator/span where applicable; no fabricated evidence
provenance.rule: No type promotion; synthetic fixtures are engineering-only; rights and split references do not themselves authorize admission

null_reasons.rule: Each null value requires a per-field reason; missing observations are not zero; non-null fields must not carry null reasons

time.relative_rule: Relative milliseconds require an exact common clock_domain/session; never chronological admission or cross-domain joins
time.unknown_rule: Null absolute availability; fail closed. Retrieval time is not historical publication time.
time.ordering: Same-time events require independently evidenced ordering; timestamps alone do not establish causal order

units.native_money: Exact Python int, never bool/float/string coercion; unsigned u64 for individual lamport/raw_token on-chain amounts
units.token_decimals: Verified mint u8 decimals required for raw_token quantities
units.ledger_totals: Signed deltas and aggregates require separate explicit bounds; unsigned native-amount validator is not an entire accounting model
units.price: Exact rational numerator/denominator and verified quote/base decimals; never binary float
units.fraction: Bounded rational with named denominator; exact rounding policy/version; consumer validation incomplete

dependencies.per_field: Each value declares exact immutable source-field references; dependency clocks and times are carried, not inferred
dependencies.formula: available_at = max(dependency available_at) + nonnegative integer compute_delay_ms
dependencies.missing_or_unknown: Fail closed with null available_at/reason; relative-only allowed only inside the same evidenced domain
dependencies.source_leaf: Requires actual observed availability as a dependency; empty sets cannot invent a time
dependencies.ancestry: Inherit all parents source rights and split restrictions; split resolution owned by separate module
dependencies.context_export: Allowlisted field lineage only; no future outcomes, censoring or oracle labels in decision inputs; label bytes kept separate

canonical_envelope_v1.validation_scope: schema.py enforces native amounts and identity; availability.py enforces availability arithmetic/clock gating. Other contracts remain descriptive and incomplete.
